name: 77088 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77088 (Houston) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (51% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77088 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
